annotations.title: An app's growth brief and campaigns

description: Use this when the user asks what to do next for growth, how a campaign is going, or what a move brought. One app's growth brief (audiences, promise, objective, hours, the channels the founder does, whether it is confirmed, and the constraint read from its numbers, with the numbers) and each campaign: its audience, need, link token, and its moves (a page, a list, a link, a thread reply, a creator, a custom product page), each with its state (prepared, done, live as read back, dropped), what was prepared for it (the pitch or reply to send), where it can be seen, what the live read found, and its outcome (measuring, not enough data, blocked, activity seen, better or worse than before, can't tell, done) with why and the numbers it came from. Better is said only against a baseline; visits or citations alone are activity. The brief's plan is this week's work Apptiller chose within the founder's hours, with what it deferred and why, what past moves brought, and judged page changes to revise. site_issues are the technical problems the weekly site check found on the app's important pages (gone, failing, noindex, canonical elsewhere, text only after JavaScript, missing title, description or H1, broken links, missing from the sitemap), each with its fix. Moves and states are the same as the web app's Campaigns page.
